title: stachys palustris var. glabra
intro: Stachys palustris var. glabra, commonly known as Smooth Marsh Woundwort, is a variety of flowering plant in the mint family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating wounds and skin irritations, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The health benefits of Smooth Marsh Woundwort include wound healing, reduction of inflammation, and protection against infections, making it a valuable natural remedy for skin and wound care.
